text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby's voice echoes
through the empty waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
……Never again
must I run such a pathetic race.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Be magnificent. Be supreme.
Always shine with the greatest brilliance...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: This time for sure, I must fulfill my duty.
